## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive (Energy, Utilities, Financials, Healthcare). Confirmation: mixed sector returns with only four sectors positive and leadership concentrated in Utilities/Industrials/Tech, plus major divergences among large caps — supports a neutral read.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Energy leads: XOM (1W: +1.76% | 1M: +3.66%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +3.34% | 1M: +11.20%) ABOVE TREND. Utilities strong: VST (1W: +8.91% | 1M: +5.60%) ABOVE TREND, CEG (1W: +8.03% | 1M: +14.68%) ABOVE TREND. Financials modest: JPM (1W: +0.29% | 1M: +0.66%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Technology lagging overall with mixed leaders and weakness: GOOGL (1W: -2.28% | 1M: -5.33%) BELOW TREND, ADBE (1W: -8.58% | 1M: +2.41%) CORRECTION. Industrials weak: UNP (1W: -5.35% | 1M: -1.50%) BELOW TREND, LMT (1W: -6.26% | 1M: -9.32%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Discretionary soft: BKNG (1W: -6.00% | 1M: -6.80%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: DE (1W: +10.03% | 1M: +12.80%) ABOVE TREND, VST (1W: +8.91% | 1M: +5.60%) ABOVE TREND, CEG (1W: +8.03% | 1M: +14.68%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +7.07% | 1M: -4.02%) RECOVERY, META (1W: +6.70% | 1M: +4.56%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Concentrated (3 sectors in Top 5). Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: UNP (1W: -5.35% | 1M: -1.50%) BELOW TREND, BKNG (1W: -6.00% | 1M: -6.80%) BELOW TREND, LMT (1W: -6.26% | 1M: -9.32%) BELOW TREND, PLTR (1W: -6.42% | 1M: +11.81%) CORRECTION, MNST (1W: -6.49% | 1M: -6.92%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in Industrials and select high-multiple names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Top 1W movers: DE (1W: +10.03% | 1M: +12.80%) ABOVE TREND, VST (1W: +8.91% | 1M: +5.60%) ABOVE TREND, CEG (1W: +8.03% | 1M: +14.68%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +7.07% | 1M: -4.02%) RECOVERY, NVDA (1W: +5.89% | 1M: +5.19%) ABOVE TREND. Note major divergence: multiple large caps (INTC, PLTR, ADBE, INTU, MSFT) show 1W vs 1M mismatches — MAJOR DIVERGENCE; watch for trend confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Mixed with concentration among winners; NVDA (1W: +5.89% | 1M: +5.19%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +6.70% | 1M: +4.56%) ABOVE TREND, but GOOGL (1W: -2.28% | 1M: -5.33%) BELOW TREND and ADBE (1W: -8.58% | 1M: +2.41%) CORRECTION — Tech breadth weak relative to index (Tech: ~8/24 positive).

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Modestly constructive and stable: JPM (1W: +0.29% | 1M: +0.66%) ABOVE TREND with broader sector flat-to-slightly-positive; V (1W: -1.71% | 1M: +1.43%) CORRECTION suggests rotating leadership within the group (Financials: ~9/20 positive).

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Mixed but defensives holding up: JNJ (1W: +2.68% | 1M: +7.63%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +1.75% | 1M: +8.59%) ABOVE TREND, while SYK (1W: -8.33% | 1M: -10.17%) BELOW TREND shows dispersion (Healthcare: ~9/17 positive).

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor exposure to selective Energy and Utilities leaders (XOM, CVX, VST) and Industrials showing momentum (DE) while reducing exposure to structurally weak large-cap names that show CORRECTION (ADBE, PLTR, INTU). Style: mixed; remain selective given MAJOR DIVERGENCE across mega-caps.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: NVDA (1W: +5.89% | 1M: +5.19%) ABOVE TREND, DE (1W: +10.03% | 1M: +12.80%) ABOVE TREND, VST (1W: +8.91% | 1M: +5.60%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: ADBE (1W: -8.58% | 1M: +2.41%) CORRECTION, PANW (1W: -10.32% | 1M: -7.30%) BELOW TREND, UNP (1W: -5.35% | 1M: -1.50%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Energy (Breadth strong; Energy: 7/10 positive) and Utilities (Utilities: 8/10 positive).  
BEARISH: Technology (Tech: ~8/24 positive) and Industrials (Industrials: ~5/15 positive) given recent weakness in key names.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
NVDA 1W momentum hold important for risk-on continuation (NVDA (1W: +5.89% | 1M: +5.19%) ABOVE TREND). DE breakout continuation to confirm industrial rotation (DE (1W: +10.03% | 1M: +12.80%) ABOVE TREND). ADBE short-term support test critical (ADBE (1W: -8.58% | 1M: +2.41%) CORRECTION).

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
VST (+50): Bridgewater position shift to Vistra; price confirming — VST (1W: +8.91% | 1M: +5.60%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed.  
PLTR (+55): Q2 beat/raised guidance but price weakening short-term — PLTR (1W: -6.42% | 1M: +11.81%) CORRECTION — sentiment diverging.  
SYK (+70): FDA-related app headline but price falling — SYK (1W: -8.33% | 1M: -10.17%) BELOW TREND — clear divergence.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
MSFT (-45): Litigation headlines with negative press and short-term weakness — MSFT (1W: -2.69% | 1M: +0.16%) CORRECTION — sentiment aligns with near-term pullback.  
WMT (-55): DOJ beef probe headline while price is up this week — WMT (1W: +3.93% | 1M: -4.17%) RECOVERY — sentiment diverging, monitor.  
TSLA (-45): Safety probe press versus recent strength — TSLA (1W: +1.53% | 1M: +10.81%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment diverging.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with style mixed / no clear leadership. NVDA (1W: +5.89% | 1M: +5.19%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +6.70% | 1M: +4.56%) ABOVE TREND and DE (1W: +10.03% | 1M: +12.80%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: MAJOR DIVERGENCE among large caps (INTC, PLTR, ADBE, MSFT) and several sentiment/price divergences (SYK, WMT) — wait for confirmation.
